title: 南区公用工程趋势分析·记录本A（可重演链）

cells.comment: // 格1：装入带版本原始表（相对路径，单位随列声明）
cells.code:
LOAD ../data/raw/elec_monthly.csv AS elec_raw
LOAD ../data/raw/water_monthly.csv AS water_raw

cells.comment: // 格2：过滤，只保留南区教学口径
cells.code:
FILTER elec_raw -> elec_south WHERE region == 'South'
FILTER water_raw -> water_south WHERE region == 'South'

cells.comment: // 格3：按月+区域连接（北区无用电记录，自然淘汰）
cells.code: JOIN elec_south WITH water_south ON month,region AS joined

cells.comment: // 格4：派生单位强度纵列（维度 energy/volume 自动推断；单位随勘误口径为 Wh/m3）
cells.code: DERIVE joined -> enriched SET intensity_wh_per_m3[Wh/m3] = electricity_kwh / water_m3

cells.comment: // 格5：按区域分组汇总（可重复运行，结果确定）
cells.code: GROUP enriched -> region_agg BY region AGG elec_sum=sum(electricity_kwh), water_sum=sum(water_m3), months=count(month)

cells.comment: // 格6：按月份排序形成月度趋势表
// 格7：把月度趋势表存成带版本的中间依赖（前格生成、后格装入）
// 格8【A 版】重新装入自己前格生成的带版本中间表

cells.code:
SAVE trend_reloaded TO out/trend_table.csv
SAVE region_agg TO out/region_summary.csv

cells.comment: // 格10：出提报趋势图（电、水各一面板，面板同高）
cells.code: PLOT trend_reloaded x=month series=electricity_kwh,water_m3 AS out/trend_chart.svg TITLE 南区月度用电与用水趋势
